title: Evidence Before Claim is enforced for requirement closure
acceptance_criteria: Every CLOSED_VERIFIED row has acceptance criteria, a current verified PASS evidence item, a reproducible source, and authorized closure approval
verification_method: Registry validator plus independent sample audit
required_evidence: Evidence ledger entry; source URL; exact commit/run; reviewer decision
weight_rationale: Core governance invariant; provisional until baseline weighting is approved
notes: Policy is documented in repository rules; universal enforcement across all workflows is not yet proven.

title: Preserve original KAIZO Library as source of preservation unless governance changes SSOT
acceptance_criteria: All transferred assets retain source lineage; no source is deleted or silently promoted; any SSOT change has an approved governance decision
verification_method: Source-to-mirror lineage audit
required_evidence: Inventory, manifest, checksums, approved SSOT decision
weight_rationale: Protects authoritative sources and provenance; provisional weight
notes: Existing docs state the boundary; full current lineage reconciliation remains open.

title: Reconcile all identified source-library artifacts with the GitHub mirror
acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope source artifact has a disposition and either an exact verified mirror or an approved reason for exclusion; binary matches require SHA-256 equality
verification_method: Manifest reconciliation and checksum verification
required_evidence: Complete source inventory; transfer manifest; hash verification records
weight_rationale: Source completeness and auditability; provisional weight
notes: Snapshot dated 2026-09-29 identifies 69 files, including 48 binary/document/archive items; complete transfer was explicitly pending.

title: Clearly distinguish Core Engine proposal, verification, and production deployment state
acceptance_criteria: Current documentation and evidence identify proposal status, verification status, production target, and exact deployed build without conflating them
verification_method: Document/code/deployment reconciliation
required_evidence: Approved architecture record; deployment identity evidence
weight_rationale: Prevents architecture and deployment status confusion; provisional weight
notes: README dated 2026-09-29 states Core Engine v2.0 is an Implementation Proposal and production deployment is not claimed.

title: Approve and consistently identify canonical production evidence target(s)
acceptance_criteria: Each production workflow declares an approved target; run output identifies host and deployed commit/build; evidence from one host is never used to prove another host
verification_method: Review workflow configuration and execute safe live smoke checks
required_evidence: Approved target decision; workflow run URL; live host/build identity
weight_rationale: Critical to prevent false production claims; provisional weight
notes: Issue #154 records mismatch between FastAPI Cloud commercial evidence target and Railway containment deployment.

title: Anonymous requests are denied with an authorization result that proves policy enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated protected requests return the expected 401/403; 503 is classified HOLD and never counted as authorization PASS
verification_method: Automated test and live request against approved target
required_evidence: Passing test output and current live HTTP status evidence
weight_rationale: Security gate; provisional weight
notes: PR #164 describes the required correction; current merge/check status must be verified before closure.

title: Verify production OIDC issuer, audience, JWKS, claims, and exact deployed build
acceptance_criteria: Valid approved identity is accepted; invalid token is denied; issuer, audience, JWKS, claims and deployed build identity are independently confirmed on the canonical host
verification_method: Live positive and negative OIDC tests plus independent review
required_evidence: Run URL; exact host/build; redacted assertions; reviewer approval
implementation_refs: Auth0/OIDC configuration and backend auth middleware
weight_rationale: Identity is a prerequisite to authorization; provisional weight
notes: Historical OIDC evidence does not establish the current deployed build without a current retest.

title: Enforce route-specific role, parent/resource, tenant, consent, and audit policies
acceptance_criteria: Actual registered route table is reconciled with a route manifest; each protected route has explicit policy and positive/negative tests; generic mounted-route backstop is not treated as complete policy
verification_method: Route inventory, policy review, actual-app tests, independent red-team
required_evidence: Route manifest; test runs; coverage report; independent retest
weight_rationale: Core authorization integrity; provisional weight
notes: PR #128 explicitly lists route-specific policies and full route-table reconciliation as remaining blockers.

title: Prove cross-tenant no-read/no-write and same-tenant allowed access with persisted non-empty records
acceptance_criteria: Two distinct trusted tenant identities are tested against non-empty persisted records; same-tenant authorized access passes and cross-tenant/wrong-tenant access is denied without read or write
verification_method: Live tenant-isolation workflow and independent retest
required_evidence: Workflow run; identities/claims redacted; record counts; allow/deny results; exact host/build
weight_rationale: Critical isolation gate; provisional weight
notes: PR #165 says Auth0 action/client/secrets setup and live workflow pass are still required before claiming isolation.

title: Verify trusted guardian relationship and active, revoked, missing, or expired consent behavior
acceptance_criteria: Only a verified guardian relationship and active exact-scope consent authorize the intended action; missing, revoked, expired, or unverified relationship denies access and creates required audit evidence
verification_method: Database integration plus live positive/negative authorization tests
required_evidence: Test results; relationship/consent state transitions; audit verification
weight_rationale: Sensitive child-data protection; provisional weight
notes: Candidate-code tests and historical runs must be reconciled with current production state.

title: Prove tenant-scoped durable audit records and fail-safe behavior on audit-store failure
acceptance_criteria: Required audit events persist atomically with correct tenant and actor scope; records survive process restart; failure behavior matches policy and is tested
verification_method: Persistence integration and production-safe audit verification
required_evidence: Database evidence; read-after-write; restart persistence; failure-path tests
weight_rationale: Auditability and incident reconstruction; provisional weight
notes: A historical DB-04 PASS is not by itself proof of the complete current audit policy.

title: Keep global evidence publisher disabled until explicit approved role and tenant policy is proven
acceptance_criteria: Publisher remains disabled unless an approved policy is configured and verified; publisher allow, non-publisher deny, wrong-tenant deny, forged verifier reject, immutable IDs and durable audit tests pass
verification_method: Configuration audit and positive/negative security tests
required_evidence: Redacted config evidence; workflow/test output; policy approval
weight_rationale: Prevents unsafe publication; provisional weight
notes: Issue #151 explicitly says to keep publisher disabled until a verified role/tenant policy is configured.

title: Verify database persistence on the currently approved production deployment
acceptance_criteria: A safe approved write is read back from durable storage after restart or equivalent persistence boundary on the exact deployed build; no secret or sensitive payload is exposed
verification_method: Production-safe persistence test and independent review
required_evidence: Run/commit identity; redacted write/read result; persistence proof
implementation_refs: Database adapter; migration and persistence workflows
weight_rationale: Historical persistence evidence exists but current full-state validation is needed; provisional weight
notes: Commit title records DB-04 production persistence PASS on 2026-10-19; does not close all Phase 4 audit/policy requirements.

title: Reconcile the current candidate commit with required CI and release gates
acceptance_criteria: All required workflows pass on the exact candidate commit; skipped, stale, queued, or unrelated-commit runs do not count; failed and cancelled runs are resolved or explicitly accepted
verification_method: Workflow inventory and run-to-commit reconciliation
required_evidence: Required-check list; run IDs; conclusion; head SHA; exception approvals
weight_rationale: Required to ensure the release candidate is the tested candidate; provisional weight
notes: Historical 21/21 reports in PR #128 refer to named historical heads and must not be assumed current.

title: Reconcile every phase, epic, feature, and dependency into the master registry
acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope phase, epic, feature, dependency, and acceptance criterion has a canonical registry row or an approved explicit exclusion; all source references are preserved
verification_method: Crosswalk audit against roadmap, issues, PRs, code, tests, and evidence
required_evidence: Feature inventory; phase crosswalk; dependency graph; signed baseline decision
implementation_refs: Project roadmap; feature and phase records
weight_rationale: Necessary for a defensible project-wide denominator; provisional weight
notes: A historical Phase 5 freeze record and the current open Phase 4 gates must be reconciled, not conflated.

title: Freeze baseline scope and weights before issuing an official completion percentage
acceptance_criteria: Inventory completeness, duplicate resolution, scope, weights, and approval are recorded; calculator suppresses official percentage until controls pass
verification_method: Deterministic calculator plus independent recomputation
required_evidence: Approved baseline control JSON; validation output; reviewer sign-off
weight_rationale: Protects against denominator manipulation and false precision; provisional weight
notes: This initial baseline is intentionally marked incomplete.

title: Establish commercial readiness from complete end-to-end user journeys, not deployment alone
acceptance_criteria: Every declared commercial journey passes from user interface through API and durable data with authorization, errors, audit, and documented support boundaries
verification_method: End-to-end acceptance testing and production pilot review
required_evidence: Journey matrix; E2E runs; production pilot evidence; support and rollback plan
implementation_refs: Coach/Commercial product surfaces and API services
weight_rationale: Commercial readiness is distinct from technical deployment; provisional weight
notes: No complete current commercial end-to-end evidence package was established in this seed pass.

title: Recover the authoritative original overall 17-phase plan or approve a replacement baseline
acceptance_criteria: Link the original authoritative 17-phase plan and closure evidence, or obtain an explicit approved replacement baseline; keep the five strategic phases, recovered 17-step board, productization phases, runtime Phase 7, and P01-P17 portfolio distinct.
verification_method: Source recovery and owner-approved taxonomy decision
required_evidence: Authoritative source or signed replacement decision; phase-to-evidence crosswalk
blocker_refs: Original overall plan not recovered in reviewed sources
weight_rationale: A valid phase denominator is prerequisite to phase completion accounting; provisional weight
notes: The recovery audit explicitly says the original overall 17-phase plan was not recovered and the reported 7/17 completion remains unverified.

title: Recover and reconcile the authoritative FEAT-001–FEAT-075 canonical backlog
acceptance_criteria: Each FEAT-001 through FEAT-075 has a source-backed canonical title, charter, domain, epic, objective, dependencies, priority, status, implementation state, verification state, production state, evidence, PR, commit, test, and notes; missing fields are explicitly unresolved rather than invented.
verification_method: Extract authoritative backlog and cross-check IDs against code, issues, PRs, tests, and evidence
required_evidence: Canonical backlog source; 75-row crosswalk; evidence links and discrepancy report
blocker_refs: Canonical 75-row backlog not present in the reviewed master project record
weight_rationale: Required to build a complete feature denominator without fabricating feature names or status; provisional weight
notes: The master project record explicitly marks the 75-feature register incomplete and says source extraction is required. The new crosswalk preserves IDs but deliberately does not invent missing titles.

title: Reconcile project taxonomies and preserve unmapped relationships
acceptance_criteria: All strategic phases, 17 board steps, productization phases, P01-P17/P18-P24, EPIC-01–15, FEAT-001–075, K/PACK/GAP/G12/G13 and runtime tracks are represented in a crosswalk; unknown relationships remain explicitly unmapped until approved.
verification_method: Crosswalk audit and independent review
required_evidence: Scope crosswalk; source citations; conflict/duplicate register; approved mappings
blocker_refs: Taxonomies have explicitly documented boundaries and unresolved mappings
weight_rationale: Prevents invalid denominator aggregation and double-counting; provisional weight
notes: A 129-row crosswalk was added for 5 strategic phases, 17 board steps, 17 product portfolio items, 15 epics, and 75 feature IDs. Feature titles and status remain unverified until the authoritative backlog is recovered.
